contentBlocks.text: You wrote a full opinion paragraph yesterday. Today let's learn special vocabulary — linking words — that make your reasons connect smoothly instead of feeling like a list.

Linking words include: because, for example, also, in addition, and for these reasons. Compare: 'Pets teach responsibility. Pets reduce stress.' versus 'Pets teach responsibility. In addition, they can reduce stress.' The second version flows better! Try rewriting two sentences from your own paragraph, adding a linking word to connect them.
Linking words are small changes that make a big difference in how smoothly your writing reads. Tomorrow is review day — we'll polish and finish a complete opinion paragraph.

objectives: Recognize and use linking words (because, for example, also, in addition, for these reasons) to connect ideas
Revise a pair of choppy sentences by adding an appropriate linking word
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Read the two pet-sentence examples aloud and discuss which flows better and why.
2. Introduce the list of linking words together.
3. Practice adding a linking word to 2-3 choppy sentence pairs.
4. Move to the worksheet: revise sentences from their own paragraph using linking words.
5. Close by reading the revised paragraph aloud, noticing the improved flow.
differentiationTips: Struggling: provide a short list of 2-3 linking words to choose from, rather than the full list at once
Ready for more: challenge the child to use a different linking word for each reason in their paragraph
For a child who enjoys precision, discuss which linking word fits best in each specific spot and why
teacherGuide.answerKey: Open-ended revision — check that the added linking word makes grammatical sense and genuinely improves the connection between the two sentences.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Using linking words is a core Grade 3 opinion-writing standard (matching Common Core W.3.1c) that makes reasons within a paragraph connect clearly, completing this week's opinion-writing toolkit.

generationData.instructions: Rewrite each sentence pair using a linking word to connect them smoothly.

prompts.prompt: Pets teach responsibility. Pets reduce stress. (Rewrite with a linking word.)
Recess helps students focus. Recess is fun. (Rewrite with a linking word.)
